description: This file declares the SystemTime class, which implements the ISystemTime interface. It manages system time status, time zone information, and event handling related to system time changes within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: A class that manages system time and timezone updates, event handling, and exposes methods to check system time availability and timezone offset.

methods.name: SystemTime
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SystemTime object with a reference to the shell interface.

methods.name: IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the system time is available.

methods.name: GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the current timezone offset in seconds.

methods.name: CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Creates a link to the system for time management.

methods.name: SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to system time related events.

methods.name: UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Updates internal status of system time.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses timezone data into accuracy and offset.

methods.name: PopulateTimeZoneTransitionMap
methods.description: Populates the transition map for timezone changes.

methods.name: EventLoop
methods.description: Main event loop handling system time events.
